title: Excalibur | Stamina Attributes  Support
body:
This unofficial compatibility pack ensures that the textures in the [Stamina Attributes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/stamina-attributes) Mod seamlessly integrate with the amazing [Excalibur](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur) resource pack.

This pack is currently incomplete and still WIP. For now, I'm not going to do the full [Stamina Attributes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/stamina-attributes) support, just the icon version of the stamina UI.

**Credits:**

*   [Maffhew](https://www.curseforge.com/members/maffhew/projects) – Creator of Excalibur
*   [TheRedBrain](https://www.curseforge.com/members/theredbrain) - Creator of Stamina Attributes
